snippet.title: Angelic: Dark Symphony - Official Cinematic Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Cinematic Teaser Trailer for Angelic: Dark Symphony, a cinematic sci-fi turn-based tactical RPG developed by Angelicore Game Studios. Players will navigate a dark narrative through strategic missions as neo-humans known as Angels. Make use of signature abilities, devastating combos, and cosmetic customization across the game's multiple campaigns. Angelic: Dark Symphony is coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
